facts.business: Adcon Capital Services Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) engaged in providing loans and advances.

auditor.name: Nishant Bajaj & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: 1. Balance in the account of Loan & Advances and Trade Receivable are subject to confirmation/reconciliation if any. 2. Interest income not recognized on outstanding advances of Rs. 280.83 lakhs due to lack of documentation. 3. Interest income not recognized on outstanding loans of Rs. 136.95 lakhs due to lack of documentation. 4. Retrospective recognition of provisioning on standard assets per RBI Master Direction considering prior period error. 5. Provision for bad and doubtful debts of Rs. 320.99 lakhs based on management assessment.

key_risks: Loan & Advances and Trade Receivable balances subject to confirmation/reconciliation
Non-recognition of interest income on advances (Rs. 280.83 lakhs) and loans (Rs. 136.95 lakhs) due to insufficient documentation
Retrospective provisioning for standard assets due to prior period non-compliance
Provision for bad and doubtful debts of Rs. 320.99 lakhs dependent on future realizations
